title: opencode: ensure generated shell snippets never contain literal \n tokens
description:
## Context
Some multi-command snippets produced by agents get pasted into shells with literal `\n` tokens between commands (e.g. `; \nbd create ...`). In zsh/bash, `\n` is treated as backslash-escaped `n`, so `\nbd` becomes the command `nbd` and fails (`command not found: nbd`).

We want the tool/agent output to be copy-paste safe: use real newlines (or `;` separators) and never emit literal `\n` tokens in command blocks.

## Skills
- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch
`epic/opencode-shell-snippets`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Shell snippets emitted by prompts/templates are copy-paste safe (no literal `\n` before a command)
- [ ] Regression coverage (unit/snapshot/e2e) for multi-command snippet formatting
- [ ] Docs/FAQ mention the pitfall and the safe patterns

## Notes
Workaround today: delete the `\n` tokens or paste with real line breaks.

title: Village: manual /work start (no auto-kick on spawn)
description:
## Context

Right now `village_spawn` immediately "kicks" worker/overseer sessions by submitting their work-loop prompt. That causes workers to start working automatically as soon as the mayor delegates.

Desired behavior: spawning creates the sessions, but workers/overseer only begin the work loop when a human manually runs the `/work` command inside that session.

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

## Branch

`epic/village-manual-work`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `village_spawn` creates sessions but does not submit the work-loop prompt by default
- [ ] Human can start work manually via `/work` in the worker/overseer session
- [ ] There is an explicit opt-in to kick immediately (arg or env) for people who want the old behavior
- [ ] Docs/instructions reflect the new default

## Notes

Keep `village_wake` as the explicit "kick" mechanism.

title: Plugin: make village_spawn not auto-kick by default

Change `village_spawn` so it can create sessions without sending the work-loop prompt. The new default should require a human to manually run `/work` in that session.

## Skills

- beads-workflow
- stack-typescript

`epic/village-manual-work`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `village_spawn` has an explicit option (e.g. `kick: true`) to send the work-loop prompt
- [ ] Default behavior is no kick (no prompt submission)
- [ ] `village_wake` continues to re-send the work-loop prompt (explicit kick)
- [ ] Tool descriptions/toasts/messages are updated to match behavior

## Notes

Keep idempotency: repeated `village_spawn` should not create duplicates.
